reuse.why: Collapses the five copied per-provider link bodies into linkBankSyncAccount, reuses link.findOrCreateBank, extracts clearAccountBankLink from unlinkAccount for the take-over, and folds Pluggy/Akahu/Fintegra downloads into one function.

duplication.why: Fintegra is added as a thin adapter on shared code; the existing copies are removed rather than extended.

placement.why: Linking stays in accounts/app.ts and downloading in sync.ts, but the duplicate-link guard is applied as a wrapper at app.method registration, so the internal link functions are unguarded if called directly.

scope.why: The consolidation goes well beyond the requests and changes details along the way (Akahu now notifies the accounts table too, GoCardless institution coercion, mask/official_name fallbacks).

maintainability.why: One link path and one guard make each rule a single edit; the split between registration-time guard and in-handler closed check is a little surprising.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All link handlers route through withBankAccountLinkGuard and linkBankSyncAccount; unlinkAccount and take-over share clearAccountBankLink.

disguised_duplication.where: The old per-provider bodies are deleted, not reshaped; providers differ only by arguments.

abstraction_drift.where: linkBankSyncAccount takes an optional fileId only for Pluggy and has official_name/mask fallbacks for GoCardless; processBankSyncDownload gets an 'akahu || fintegra' branch; no call site bypasses the helpers.
